# Rinat Sultanov

> Director of Development at Kazan Delicacies. Architect of AI transformation for manufacturing companies: sales, data and management rebuilt around AI — growth without a matching rise in headcount.

## Facts

- Role: Director of Development at Kazan Delicacies, a halal meat-processing company in Kazan, Russia.
- Company revenue: 58.6 million RUB (2023) → 869 million RUB (2025). This growth is not attributed to AI.
- 20+ years in commerce: meat industry (2006–2018), distribution to 1,000+ counterparties, cleaning-service co-founder (Astrakhan, Krasnodar, Dubai), MBA (Estonian Entrepreneurship University, 2020–2022).
- Not an AI consultant, not an integrator. Works inside a operating plant first, then with selected external companies.

## Work

- Production strategy with AI
- Analytics with AI
- Agent-led sales
- SEO + AIO / GEO

## Formats

- Diagnosis, 2–3 weeks
- 90-day pilot
- Change architecture (no more than 2–3 companies at a time)
